label: Crème brûlée
note: Rich custard under a hard layer of caramelised sugar; earliest known recipe Massialot 1691, egg yolks and milk with a pinch of flour; some versions use cream instead of milk

about.text: A rich custard topped with a crisp layer of burnt sugar, served slightly chilled.
